memory_candidates.content: When citing Lean declarations by fully qualified name for an external consumer, do not trust a report's file-prefixed short names (Sound.foo, Check.bar): the file name is not the namespace. Resolve each cited line's enclosing namespace mechanically with an awk namespace/end stack walk over the file, and confirm the declaration keyword by grep. In PlusSlicedCertificate/ every file opens FormalSystem.Metalogic.Decidability then PlusSlicedCertificate (Fixture.lean and FixtureStable.lean nest Fixture), while Embed*.lean put embedding results under WitnessFamily; three short names (Certifies, plusRefutes_of_certifies, StabFaithful) collide with older WitnessFamily/PlusSharingWitnessFamily homonyms, so a last-component grep alone resolves to the wrong declaration.

Wire-format extension rule adopted from HOA's capitalised-header discipline: when extending a JSON certificate envelope with a new semantics-bearing key, OMIT the old key an unaware consumer would otherwise silently reinterpret (here: a sliced envelope carries `slices` and no `lassos`), and forbid both keys in one document. Both re-checkers (BimodalTools.CanonicalWire.decodeOptLassos and ModelChecker's raw.get("lassos", [])) read an absent key as empty and reject structurally, so an old consumer fails loudly instead of checking the wrong object.
